title: DA0xIZM
tagline: DAO Hack to interact with web3 protocols and leran about DAO in depth.
description: This project aims to combine the best of web3 through all things DAO. It incorporates some of the best features of web3 including DEFI protocols, NFT and general ethereum blockchain interactivity. Superfluid for streams, ipfs to store data alone with lens protocols for social intergration.
how_its_made: This is focus on mobile first using react native along with hardhat, solidity, next js and tailwind. The goal is to present the user an opportunity to join a DAO through incentives of NFTs. Once logged in, you can sign up and work towards being whitelisted to be a part of the DAO. Once a member, one can experience the many benefits that a DAO has to offer.
